call_points.text: Two new CDMO contracts expected to close in early H2FY27 remain on track.
Dahej and Ankleshwar expansions on track, adding 160KL and 110KL respectively.
Inventory is expected to rise over the next few quarters as the company builds stock at favourable prices.
Raw material prices rising from solvents into KSM due to the war situation; only part passed on to customers.
Management flagged no major compliance pressure; Ankleshwar received VAI and Dahej NAI from the FDA.
R&D spend to settle around 4% of sales, focused on new API and second-generation processes.
Management guided for FY27 capex of about ₹540 crores, funded entirely through internal accruals.
EBITDA margins for FY27 are expected to be sustained in the range of 30% to 32%.

guidance.statement: For FY27, we remain confident of delivering high single-digit revenue growth, with margins sustained above 30%, supported by improving operating leverage and a rising contribution from new products.
Revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY27, skewed towards H2
EBITDA margin sustained in the 30% to 32% range
Capex of approximately ₹540 Cr in FY27
R&D to settle at a steady state of around 4% of sales

operating_notes.text: Recognised ₹25.66 Cr exceptional charge in FY26 due to past service costs from New Labour Codes implementation.
Cumulative DMF/CEP filings reached 611 as of March 31, 2026.
GPL business has more than 50 commercial products with the customer and is historically weighted to H2.
High-potent API portfolio has 29 products in the active grid with a total addressable market of $82 billion; 13 validated, 7 in advanced development.
617 DMF and CEP filings globally as of June 30, 2026.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹689.12 Cr (+6.1% YoY), net profit ₹162.66 Cr (+14.7% YoY).
Alivus Life Sciences reported FY26 revenue of ₹2,551.8 Cr (+6.9% YoY) and PAT of ₹564.5 Cr (+16.2% YoY).
Alivus Life Sciences Limited (formerly Glenmark Life Sciences Limited) uploaded Q4 & FY2025-26 earnings call recording on May 15, 2026, via its website.
Alivus Life Sciences Limited scheduled a one-on-one virtual meeting with Karma Capital on May 22, 2026, under Regulation 30 of SEBI.

Alivus Life Sciences Limited’s **Rudalf Corriea** will attend an **Ambit India Access | Titans of In-Person** conference in Mumbai on **May 25, 2026**, and a **one-on-one meeting** with **Abakkus Asset Managers** on **May 27, 2026**.
Alivus Life Sciences reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹689 Cr (+6.1% YoY) and full year FY26 revenue of ₹2,552 Cr with an EBITDA margin of 33.6%.

Alivus Life Sciences' Q1FY27 earnings call (July 31, 2026) reported revenue of ₹640 Cr (+6.4% YoY) with non-GPL up 26.5% offsetting a 52.6% GPL decline, and guided FY27 revenue growth of 10-12% with EBITDA margin of 30-32%.

Alivus Life Sciences Limited (formerly Glenmark Life Sciences Limited) invites analysts/institutional investors to its Q2 FY2026-27 earnings call on October 30, 2026, from 8:30 a.m. to 9:30 a.m. (IST).
